entity.stats.summary: Resolve a GM03 snapshot query and report grouping, statistics, rejected candidates and expected-count diagnostics.

inputs.kind: Optional entity kind, default face. Same contract as entity.find.
inputs.component: Optional component reference; exclusive with scope.
inputs.occurrence: Optional occurrence reference or full path; exclusive with scope.
inputs.instances: Optional boolean false; enumerate repeated/nested physical instances when true.
inputs.frame: Optional context/component/root or {component:Ref}, {occurrence:Ref}, {sketch:Ref}, {datum:name,component?,occurrence?}. Same rigid frame rules as entity.find.
inputs.filters: Same filters as entity.find, including filters.attributes:[{group,name,value,owner}] exact string predicates. owner is required: native reads the nativeObject/native definition; proxy reads only the exact contextual proxy; occurrence reads the candidate occurrence or its exact context. No owner fallback. Missing attrs are nonmatches. Proxy/occurrence predicates require occurrence scope, kind:occurrence or instances:true; unavailable on component candidates.
inputs.expect: Optional count or inclusive {min?,max?}; default min 0. Failed expectation returns all matches and status fail.
inputs.unique: Optional boolean; true enforces count 1, exclusive with expect; stats always retains its aggregate result shape.
inputs.groupBy: Optional distinct array: kind, geometry, component, occurrence, body, radius, length, axis, level. Exact-value groups; unoriented axes canonicalized to 12 decimals.

limitations: Snapshot only; rerun after geometry/pose/parameter changes. No native associative selection rule.
Statistics report count/missing/min/max/sum/mean for radius, length, area, volume with units; unknown measurements remain null, never fabricated zero.
Native live acceptance is pending. AABB bounds are conservative transformed native boxes; not exact containment or collision tests.
